title: Design of the CHIRON high-resolution spectrometer at CTIO
what_was_studied: Fibre feed, enclosure and optical design
numerical_result: The design targeted a fixed 410 to 870 nm format with multiple resolution modes
remaining_question: Design intent is not achieved long-term RV performance

title: Performance of the CHIRON high-resolution echelle spectrograph
numerical_result: The report characterizes resolution modes up to about 140000 and early stability tests
remaining_question: Commissioning tests need target and timescale context

title: CHIRON a fiber-fed spectrometer for precise radial velocities
numerical_result: CHIRON provides 410 to 870 nm coverage and resolving power about 80000 with the slicer
remaining_question: Instrument specifications do not set one RV precision for all programmes
